text: Monster Beverage went public in 1990 under its former name Hansen's Natural; the Monster Energy brand is created by Hansen Natural Company, now Monster Beverage Corporation.
short: Monster Energy is made by Monster Beverage Corporation, public since 1990.

source.name: Wikipedia – Monster Beverage
source.quote: In 1990, Hansen's (original ticker symbol: HANS) went public with an initial public offering.

additionalSources.name: Wikipedia – Monster Energy
additionalSources.quote: created by Hansen Natural Company (now Monster Beverage Corporation)

additionalSources.name: Wikipedia – Monster Beverage
additionalSources.quote: The Coca-Cola Company bought a 16.7% stake for $2.15 billion in Monster Beverage Corp in 2015.
